title: Advances in nanotechnology-based approaches for the treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38668-38688
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07193J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bicai Tang, Rui Huang, Wenjuan Ma
Emerging nanoparticles (NPs), including biomembrane-based, polymeric, metallic, and non-metallic inorganic NPs, have offered powerful and promising approaches for the diagnosis and treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC).
